video_title: Dejounte Murray REQUESTS A TRADE from the Pelicans 🚨 Could Zion be next? | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Dejounte Murray requests a trade from the New Orleans Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: Dejounte Murray has requested a trade out of the organization
quotes.quote: Pelicans guard Dejounte Murray has requested a trade out of the organization and now his agent Rich Paul and the franchise are working toward a resolution. In the last several days, Murray has met with the organization and has made it clear that he wants to go somewhere else and play a meaningful key role on another team. We have seen Dejounte Murray, especially on social media, express his frustration with how things are going there. Clearly, it is not working out there. He is not going to be playing basketball in New Orleans for the time moving forward here. In his absence now, the Pelicans will be turning over that lead guard position to Jeremiah Fears, who has shined without Dejounte Murray in that lineup so far this year. Both sides will be working now on a trade for Dejounte Murray out of New Orleans.
quotes.social_post: Dejounte Murray has requested a trade from the Pelicans. Shams Charania reports that Murray has made it clear he wants to play a key role on another team and will not be playing for New Orleans moving forward.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Dumars overcompensating in trade negotiations after past criticism
quotes.excerpt: It is like he is almost overcompensating trying to make sure that he can win a press conference.
quotes.quote: It has not been a great run for Joe Dumars since he has been in that chair in New Orleans. He got ridiculed for what he gave up to get Derrick Queen. He got ridiculed for the CJ McCollum for Jordan Poole trade. And so when teams are calling, hey, we are interested in trading Dejounte Murray, Herb Jones, he is asking for the moon. It is like he is almost overcompensating trying to make sure that he can win a press conference after getting just hammered in the media over the deals that he has made.
quotes.social_post: Tim Bontemps suggests Joe Dumars is overcompensating in trade negotiations for the Pelicans after being ridiculed for past deals, noting that he is currently asking for the moon in return for players like Dejounte Murray.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: New Orleans Pelicans roster pieces do not complement each other
quotes.excerpt: You have some really good pieces that would fit in some other places, just have not fit together.
quotes.quote: One of the things that I look at that team is, I know some guys that do this all the time. They have a lot of designer clothes on, but they just don't match. You have the Versace and the Gucci, but you are not supposed to wear it all at one time. And so you have some really good pieces that would fit in some other places, just have not fit together. Now, did you know that was going to happen if you are Joe Dumars? Possibly, obviously not. But to me, the pieces don't fit and they don't complement each other.
quotes.social_post: Kendrick Perkins on the Pelicans roster construction: They have a lot of designer clothes on, but they just do not match. You have the Versace and the Gucci, but you are not supposed to wear it all at one time.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelicans need a cultural reset and direction during Zion Williamson era
quotes.excerpt: I always say you have to pick a direction, either you are moving up or you are moving down.
quotes.quote: It is time for the cultural reset. Because I think of, we all love basketball, I think of the fans, and you want a product that you can believe in. And when I think of the Pelicans, this is year eight of Zion. I know that makes us feel old. I know that he sat out, it has been a time here or there. This is not where you want to go. I always say you have to pick a direction, either you are moving up or you are moving down. They have had the fourth-worst record in the league cumulatively ever since they have got Zion. They have got to make a choice on how they want to build the future with their identity, with the stars that they champion.
quotes.social_post: Chiney Ogwumike says it is time for a cultural reset in New Orleans. With the Pelicans holding the fourth worst record in the league since drafting Zion Williamson, she argues the team must pick a direction for their future identity.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelicans face difficulty finding a trade market for Zion Williamson
quotes.excerpt: Can you trade Zion? Sure. Can you get a big return for him? No way.
quotes.quote: I was texting with an executive asking about a potential Zion market. He says, can you trade Zion? Sure. Can you get a big return for him? No way.
quotes.social_post: Tim Bontemps reports that an NBA executive told him that while you could trade Zion Williamson, there is no way to get a big return for him at this stage.
